title: Your booking is on hold - confirm in 30 minutes
scenario: An email from a booking site says your hotel reservation is on hold and will be released in 30 minutes unless you re-enter your card details through the link provided.

answers.A: Log into the booking site directly through its app or a typed web address to check the reservation.
answers.B: Re-enter your card through the link to keep the booking.
answers.C: Re-enter your card, and also confirm the CVV by reply email.

explanation: A real booking hold doesn't require re-entering full card details through an emailed link with a short countdown - that combination is a phishing pattern, not a booking system.
proTip: Check a booking inside the app you booked with, not through a link that found you.
